Definition: of Latin origin; a semicinctium or half-girding, i.e. narrow covering (apron):--apron.
BiblicalUsage: Simikinthion is an apron, a workman's half-girdle, and it appears once, where handkerchiefs and aprons carried from Paul's body to the sick drove diseases away and cast out evil spirits at Ephesus.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe God honours the apron of a working man, because Paul's work clothes carried healing to the sick who never met him.
